met_analysis:
The Deep Depression (Remnant of Severe Cyclonic Storm “Akvan”) over south coastal Odisha moved northwards with a speed of 12 kmph during past 06 hours, weakened into a Depression and lies centered at 1730 hours IST of today, the 20th November, 2026, over south Odisha near latitude 20.2°N and longitude 84.9°E, about 70 km south-southwest of Angul (Odisha), 100 km north of Gopalpur (Odisha) and 110 km west- northwest of Puri (Odisha). It is likely to move nearly northwards over Odisha and weaken into a Well Marked Low Pressure Area during next 06 hours
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Assam & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level now runs roughly along Long. 59°E to the north of Lat. 30°N.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over east Bangladesh & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
